ITEM 1 | Bright green thin slender pods, tapered ends, some with slight wrinkled surface and darker green tips, glossy sheen, moist, arranged in a loose heap on the upper-left of the plate, covering roughly 25% of plate area, about 1 cm thick bundle, spanning roughly 12 cm long | 85
ITEM 2 | Dark green crinkled leafy greens, wilted and limp with ruffled edges and some stems, slightly glossy, moist, with small pale granular bits scattered on top, piled in the lower-left center covering roughly 30% of plate, about 2 cm high mound | 110
ITEM 3 | Two pinkish-tan pieces of meat with browned, slightly charred edges and fibrous, flaky texture, one larger piece about 9 cm by 4 cm and a thinner piece beside it, slight sheen and juices, sitting on the right side of the plate next to the vegetables, roughly 1.5 cm thick | 140
